Main_Sales_Channel='AUD' will be updated on the next run. 
Main_Sales_Channel='BBC' will be deleted from the source on the next run .
Main_Sales_Channel='CAD' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed.
Main_Sales_Channel='999999' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table).


SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='AUD'
UNION ALL
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='BBC'
UNION ALL
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='CAD'
UNION ALL
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='999999'
